notes: Needs ruling (rule 11): «وزادني محمد عن أبي النعمان» is a second isnad for a second saying (the wine story), and «قال كنت ساقي القوم» is a first-person narrative whose speaker is not settled by the text; I did not add Anas or any other link to group 2.
Group 1 ends at the Companion «أنس» where the saying begins.
«أبو النعمان» and «أبي النعمان» are two spellings of the same words in the text; kept as written.
